review:
Mental II returns to the asylum on a 3-2-3-2-3 grid. Fire Frames split one to thirteen random positions into two, and Enhancer Cells under reels 2 to 4 switch on as more frames appear. Two Dead Patient symbols reveal a patient with a multiplier from x5 up to x500.

xWays, xSplit, xNudge and the new xMental pile on more features. Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with a 99,999x cap, among the highest in the catalogue. Like the original, the theme is extremely dark.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
